#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin || exit 1
task_head=${1:?exact signed head required}
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$task_head" || exit 2
test "$(git rev-parse origin/fix/listindex-numeric-5611)" = "$task_head" || exit 3
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 4
git verify-commit "$task_head" > build/listindex-native/postpush-signature.log 2>&1 || exit 5
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/fixed.sha256 > build/listindex-native/postpush-before.log || exit 6
export TMPDIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/build/listindex-tmp
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/resources/locales
unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
task_regex='^(test_prg_engine_(listindex_numeric|list_index_numeric|listitem_numeric|itemidtoindex_numeric|indextoitemid_numeric|selectedid_numeric|selected_index_numeric|itemdata_index_numeric|getcolor_default_numeric)(_(copperfin|vfp9)_session[12])?|test_prg_engine_numeric_behavior|test_prg_engine_int64_exact_expression|test_native_test_isolation_contract|test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_itemid_selectors)$'
printf '%s\n' "$task_head" > build/listindex-native/postpush.head
nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 ctest --test-dir build/listindex-gcc -V --output-on-failure --timeout 600 -j 1 -R "$task_regex" > build/listindex-native/postpush-gcc.log 2>&1
task_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > build/listindex-native/postpush-gcc.status
date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > build/listindex-native/postpush-gcc.completed-at
sha256sum build/listindex-native/postpush-gcc.log > build/listindex-native/postpush-gcc.log.sha256
test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
sha256sum -c tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/fixed.sha256 > build/listindex-native/postpush-after.log || exit 7
